summary: Stone fire observer shelter with cupola, built 1929 by the Westchester County Park Commission on Spitzenberg; FFLA lists stone ruins in a public county park.

facts.design: Stone shelter house with a cupola for a fire observer; main room planned 16 ft square
facts.status_note: FFLA lists the site as stone ruins. No source describes when the shelter fell into ruin or what remains.

access.note: Blue Mountain Reservation is a Westchester County park open seven days a week, 8 a.m. to dusk, year-round.

visit.trail_note: Park trails include hikes to the tops of Mt. Spitzenberg and Blue Mountain (county parks page).

events.note: Blue Mountain Reservation acquired (1,538-acre park now run by Westchester County Parks)

corrections.why: Blue Mountain Reservation is a Westchester County park per the county parks page. Nothing in the sources supports tribal ownership.

corrections.current: permission: On tribal land. Ask the tribe before visiting.
corrections.proposed: public: county park open 8 a.m. to dusk, year-round
corrections.why: The access level and note rest on the tribal-ownership error. The county parks page shows public hours and no permission requirement.
The reservation is the park the shelter stands in. The 1929 shelter was built by the Westchester County Park Commission, per the 1929 report quoted on the Forest Lookouts page.

sources.title: Spitzenberg Mountain (Forest Lookouts page, quoting the Scarsdale Inquirer, December 27, 1929)

notes_for_editor: Construction is known only from a December 1929 newspaper item, transcribed on the Forest Lookouts page; the paper spells Peekskill 'Peakskill' and the story uses the correct spelling. Nothing read describes the ruins today, when the shelter fell down, or whether the site is reachable apart from the park trails. The FFLA 'Stone Ruins' status is the only current-status source. Ownership and access corrections follow from the county parks page, which contradicts the record's tribal-land note. The story does not encourage climbing the ruins. No photos found; photo search not run within budget.
